dedupe_keys.name: fineprint open database on global coal and metal mining mine level production reserves waste and processing 2000 2021

description: The FINEPRINT open database on global coal and metal mining collects physical production data for coal and metal ores at the level of individual mines. It covers 1,435 individual mines, smelters and mineral refineries, with mine-level production of 80 materials from 2000 to 2021, and adds mine coordinates, ownership, mineral reserves, mining waste, transport of mining products, and mineral processing capacities and production. Coverage: global, as far as the company reports gathered allow. The data were gathered by hand from more than 2,000 freely available mining company reports, and every data point is linked to its source document. Format and access: a relational database of 12 tables on Zenodo, the processing code on GitHub (fineprint-global/compilation_mining_data), a Data Descriptor paper in Scientific Data, and visualisation in the FINEPRINT Viewer and a mine data viewer searchable by name or facility id; free. Licence: not read on the page opened; the Zenodo record's licence was not checked. Caveats: facilities are included only where freely available company reports give the figures; the series ends in 2021. Simulation uses: locations, output and transport routes of mines and processing plants for supply chain disruption and hazard exposure studies of critical materials. Related records: the FINEPRINT mining area polygonization app (platform-fineprint-mining-area-polygonization-app) maps mining areas from the same project, and the ICMM Global Mining Dataset (data-icmm-global-mining-dataset-facilities) lists many more facilities without production data.
